answer: Weakest link is proof-of-personhood: one human rents many identities. Defend anyway by binding each agent's weight to costly, unforgeable stake anchored in slow physical scarcity, like a karst aquifer's recharge — identities can't be minted fast. New agents start hollow, sponsored by staked agents who forfeit when their ward sybils out. A zephyr of throwaway accounts dies on that collateral cap.
